title: オークスの後に・受け継がれし冠

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild as Air Groove conquers the Japanese Oaks and carries on her mother's legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A new queen has been crowned, and Air Groove stands proud before her cheering fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, who had been struggling with her self-esteem, watches Air Groove run and realizes she wants to be just like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Shuka Sho, and the newly crowned queen has no intentions of slowing down.
